narrative.details: It is very kind of you to inquire about the needs that the Alliance has. In addition to all of the other collection efforts underway, we are in need of a great quantity of thorium bars, which is the task that I am in charge of. The thorium will be used in the creation of many different things for the war, foremost of which is the construction of a battalion of steam tanks to be airlifted into Silithus as soon as they are completed. Can you aid us in this endeavor, champion?
narrative.objectives: Bring 20 Thorium Bars to Dame Twinbraid at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText: So Gnoarn doesn't trust my reconnaissance abilities? I wonder why...
narrative.requestItemsText: Oh, a shipment from my brother? Splendid! Fortune truly shines on me today!
